site.about: I'm a Delhi-based Full-Stack developer and founder building thoughtful digital experiences, from intuitive interfaces to robust, real-time systems. I turn ideas into reliable products with clean code and measurable impact. I created the Finance Tracker app and I'm currently building r0, an open-source AI-powered IDE designed to bring AI-assisted coding and development workflows into a single workspace.

education.institution: Chhotu Ram Rural Institute of Technology, Delhi

highlights: Built r0, a cross-platform desktop code editor combining AI agents, an integrated terminal, Git, and database tools in one workspace.
Implemented Agent, Plan, and Ask workflows with up to 24 tool-use steps, support for 17+ AI providers, and approval-gated execution.
Added inline AI code reviews with Accept / Reject controls, multi-tab terminal sessions, and integrated Git and GitHub workflows.
Expanded the editor with language-server support, Vim mode, split panes, workspace search, debugging adapters, project previews, and installable extensions.
Designed for developer control with local-first API key management, session recovery, zero telemetry, and no subscription lock-in.
